text.tspan: "Developer gets AccessDenied on S3": check these layers in order
Tools that tell you which layer
CloudTrail: the exact denied API call, principal ARN and errorCode (S3 data events must be enabled for object calls)
IAM Policy Simulator: test the principal + action + resource · IAM Access Analyzer for unused/external access
Newer AccessDenied messages name the policy type that denied it ("... with an explicit deny in a resource-based policy")
aws s3api get-bucket-policy / get-bucket-encryption / get-public-access-block · aws s3 ls s3://bucket --debug
Fix with least privilege: add the missing action/ARN to the role, never "s3:*" or a public bucket
